We're preparing the network for bushfire season

As part of our ongoing commitment to safety and reliability, our crews are undertaking vegetation management works near powerlines to help reduce bushfire risk and strengthen network resilience. Temporary power outages may be required to carry out this work safely, and affected customers will be notified in advance wherever possible.
